Hero.headline: A Land of Giants
Hero.subtext: Standing on the shoulders of giants to see a wider world

WhoWeAre.title: Who We Are
WhoWeAre.description:
We are young giants shaping the next era.
Deep thinkers and far dreamers, gathered together.
Standing on each other's shoulders, we see the world and build the future together.

WhatWeValue.title: What We Value
WhatWeValue.curiosityDesc: The joy of learning and the drive to know more
WhatWeValue.thinkingDesc: Thinking at the scale of humanity — open, critical, from first principles
WhatWeValue.togetherDesc: Being with people who make time worth spending
